text: Hi Grace, great to see you. I brought Julian, one of our solutions engineers, so we can make this hands-on. Julian, can you walk Grace through testing a new prompt without shipping it?
Right, and no staging needed. The playground runs your new prompt against a dataset, so production never sees it.
Good question. Julian, where should Grace pull the test examples from?
Yes. Compare Models runs the same prompt across models side by side, so you see quality and cost together.
Totally fair, especially before the holidays. You run it as an experiment first and only ship the winner. Julian, what would Grace watch after launch?
And one thing on alerts: they only go to people with Arize logins, so we'd add your VP as a user.
And since your VP wants one page to look at: Julian, what would you put on that dashboard?
I'll send you the plan right now, while we're still on the call.
Thanks so much, Grace. Talk soon.
Good question. Julian, can you take that one?
